subject: general
question: Gopika Varma is a classical dancer of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Mohiniattam__ is one of the classical dance forms in India.

 __
 
• Mohiniattam is originated from the state of Kerala.
 
• Mohiniyattam derives its name from the word ‘Mohini’, a female avatar of Lord Vishnu
 
• It is performed by women in honor of the Hindu god Vishnu in his incarnation as the enchantress Mohini.
 
• Music for Mohiniattam is provided by a Karnatak (South Indian) classical music ensemble.
 
• It follows two performance categories namely, ‘Nritta’ and ‘Nritya’ mentioned in ‘Natya Shastra’.
 
• Mohiniattam was patronized by Travancore ruler Maharaja Swathi Thirunal.
 
• Vallathol Narayana Menon is the poet who revived Mohiniattam.
 
 
 
• The main exponents of Mohiniattam are:
 
 
• Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma.
 
• Sunanda Nair.
 
• **Gopika Varma.**
 
• Pallavi Krishnan.
